title: Pick a class: Cleric
caption: New character now offers the Cleric after the Assassin, the Ranger, the Gladiator, the Spiritmaster and the Templar.

title: A Cleric at level 22
caption: A Cleric character gets its own guide: Earth's Retribution first, Earth Punishment for stigma slot 1, each with its game icon.

title: Skills that fire on a condition
caption: The Build plan says which two Cleric skills fire only on a condition, such as Condemnation after Chain of Torment.

title: Cleric stats and keys
caption: The Build tab shows Attack and Critical Hit first while leveling, plus the game's default Q and E keys from your Cleric screen.
